s: The Joja Furniture Catalogue is a catalogue of furniture and decor items that can be purchased at
for 25,000g. It can also appear in the
for 30,000g, but only after completing the
. There is a 10% chance the catalogue will appear in the Traveling Cart's shop inventory.
Once placed, Right-click on the catalogue allows the player to obtain unlimited Joja-themed furniture and decor items at no cost.
Tip: Shift + Left-click on an item to add it directly to inventory, instead of attaching it to the mouse cursor.
When the player first interacts with the Joja Furniture Catalogue, the Joja Terms of Service is shown.
